coach.closer: I believe in you. More importantly, I need you to believe in you.

players.name: tuxedo_slide

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

weaknesses.detail: Pass accuracy: 29% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 71% or less)
weaknesses.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
weaknesses.coach: The passing got a little loose out there.

weaknesses.detail: Passes attempted: 14 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 15 or less)
weaknesses.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.
Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.
weaknesses.coach: We didn't see enough of you on the ball. I want you in the thick of it.

weaknesses.detail: Tackle success: 0% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 18% or less)
weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
weaknesses.coach: Diving in a bit too eager. Patience in the tackle.

players.headline: Quiet midfielder performance (7.0, below average for the position) - best at goal threat; work on passing accuracy, on-ball involvement.

coach.name: Coach Lasso
coach.opener: tuxedo_slide, a 7.0 is a touch under par for a midfielder. That's alright. Even the best tomatoes have a bruise or two.
coach.closer: Growth isn't a straight line. It's more like a squiggle. We're squiggling in the right direction.
